end.summary:
Riya gave examples of regional diversity in food, dress, festivals, and language.
Riya identified idli-dosa, parathe, phiran, lungi, Diwali, Pongal, and Lohri in context.
Riya practised comparing shared features and regional differences in harvest festivals.
Riya did not complete the explanation of how diversity connects to unity; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised finding examples of diversity in language, food, dress, and festivals across India. They correctly identified regional examples such as phiran in Kashmir, lungi in Kerala, and shared festival ideas such as giving thanks for a harvest. They were unsure how to express the shared “unity” part in the Venn-diagram task, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, invite Riya to make a two-column list of one shared feature and one regional difference for two Indian festivals.
